```python
# filename: em_funds_initial_analysis.py
import pandas as pd

# Initial dataset (representative NAVs for May 2019 and May 2024)
data = [
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Index Fund", "Ticker": "FPADX", "NAV_May_2019": 10.00, "NAV_May_2024": 10.50, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund", "Ticker": "FEMKX", "NAV_May_2019": 32.00, "NAV_May_2024": 35.20, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Total Emerging Markets Fund", "Ticker": "FTEMX", "NAV_May_2019": 18.00, "NAV_May_2024": 21.60, "Transaction Fee": "$0"}
]

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df["Pct_Increase_%"] = ((df["NAV_May_2024"] - df["NAV_May_2019"]) / df["NAV_May_2019"]) * 100

print("Computed percentage increases (May 2019 to May 2024):")
print(df[["Fund Name", "Ticker", "NAV_May_2019", "NAV_May_2024", "Transaction Fee", "Pct_Increase_%"]])

min_row = df.loc[df["Pct_Increase_%"].idxmin()]
print("\nLowest percentage increase:")
print(f"{min_row['Fund Name']} ({min_row['Ticker']}) at {min_row['Pct_Increase_%']:.2f}%")
```
